_approach: A gallop-pattern tom cascade: bar 1 places soft gallop-style tom hits on the 16th before each beat, and bar 2 lengthens them into a full three-tom (high/mid/low) 16th cascade rising to 120 while the kick thins to just the downbeat and a final pickup hit; crash lands on the last step. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
